{{Quote|Cheiko Bes was once a Jedi, but during the rise of the Dread Masters, she... lapsed. She's killed dozens across the Outer Rim, not always for credits.|Captain Hanthor|<ref name="Mission" />}}
'''Cheiko Bes''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, she fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] during the rise of the [[Dread Masters]], and joined the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group known as the [[Specialists]]. She and the rest of the unit were [[Death/Legends|killed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]].
